AntibodyType.title: AntibodyType
AntibodyType.description:
Antibody type values that go in the TYPE field of the AntibodyEntry.

NOTE:
Anything more complicated than the simple configurations below is a
"construct", i.e. a RELATION between entities of the types below.
This includes:
    - diabodies and codvs
    - exotic constructs (see, e.g., zoo here: https://doi.org/10.1080/19420862.2023.2207232)
It may, in future, also include:
    - a *full* antibody (both arms of the Y) — bispecific or otherwise.
Constructs are handled by the CHAINSHARING_CONSTRUCT and
NON_CHAINSHARING_CONSTRUCT fields in the AntibodyEntry.

ConstructType.title: ConstructType
ConstructType.description:
Construct type values for the CHAINSHARING_CONSTRUCT['TYPE'] and
NON_CHAINSHARING_CONSTRUCT['TYPE'] fields in AntibodyEntry.

Used when an antibody (VH/VL pair or SD-H or SD-L) shares physical chain(s)
with other antibodies OR when it's part of a full-Ab.
When the antibody is not in such a construct, the construct key is set to
False (no enum member).
